items.captionEn: The mats decide the room, not the other way round: a 4.5-mat tea room is a square of exactly three mat-widths with four mats pinwheeled around a half mat, and where the sunken hearth is cut — inside the host mat or outside it, in either handedness — gives the eight hearth positions that each change the procedure itself

items.name: 302-道路標識
items.caption: 道路標識（形と色で、読む前に種類が分かる）
items.captionEn: You know what kind of sign it is before you can read a word of it: shape and colour arrive first, so a yellow diamond means caution from further away than any text can be resolved — and the main sign carries no conditions at all, since when and where and to whom it applies lives on the small plate below it

items.name: 305-階段の寸法
items.caption: 階段の寸法（2H ＋ D が同じでも、急さは別物）
items.captionEn: Two staircases can both satisfy the stride rule of twice the rise plus the going equalling 610mm and still differ by twenty degrees of pitch — the formula only asks whether the step matches a stride, never how steep the climb is, and at the legal limit you cannot see the treads on the way down

items.name: 298-交通信号機
items.caption: 交通信号機（色の順は、見落としの重さで決まっている）
items.captionEn: Green sits at the end of the row because red has to sit where it is most visible: the order of the colours is not an aesthetic choice but a ranking of how badly each one would be missed — and the arrows below follow the same logic, left turn under green, straight under amber, right turn under red

items.name: 285-車いすの基本寸法
items.caption: 車いすの基本寸法（通れることと、向きを変えられることは別）
items.captionEn: Passing through and turning around are different problems: a 700mm chair clears an 800mm door but needs a 1,400mm square to turn 180 degrees and a 1,500mm circle to turn right round

items.name: 271-地籍図
items.caption: 地籍図（線ではなく、点の座標でできている）
items.captionEn: A cadastral map is not a drawing but a set of coordinates: the boundary points are held as plane rectangular coordinates, the lines merely join them, and the area falls out of the arithmetic rather than a tape measure

items.name: 269-組子の割り付け
items.caption: 組子（六角形を決めると、部材の長さも角度も決まる）
items.captionEn: Kumiko lattice is arithmetic before it is woodwork: fixing the hexagon fixes every length and angle in the pattern, and the three-way joint only lies flat because the three pieces are notched to different depths — one third, two thirds, one half

items.name: 265-建具の開き勝手と有効開口
items.caption: 建具の開き勝手（弧 1 本が、部屋の使い方を決める）
items.captionEn: The single arc on a floor plan decides how the room can be used: a 780mm frame only gives 747mm of clear opening once the leaf is in the way, and the door sweeps 0.44m² of floor that nothing else can occupy

items.caption: 販売図面（無彩色の版。壁を面で見せ、家具を描かない）
items.captionEn: The greyscale version of the same trade: walls as mass, no loose furniture

items.caption: 販売図面（作るための図ではなく、決めるための図）

items.captionEn: Hotel typical floor, twelve rooms

items.caption: 日影規制（高さではなく「影の時間」で効く）
items.captionEn: Shadow-hour zoning: the iso-shadow lines here were computed, not sketched — the inner line clears its limit but the outer one does not

items.name: 211-N値計算と接合金物
items.caption: N 値計算（壁を強くするほど、端の柱は抜けようとする）
items.captionEn: Hold-down selection (N-value method): the stronger a shear wall is, the harder it pulls its end post out of the ground

items.name: 226-用途地域13種類
items.caption: 用途地域（同じ 200m² で、延べ面積が 8 倍違う）
items.captionEn: Thirteen zoning districts: the name alone fixes nothing — coverage and floor-area ratios are chosen from a list, and the same 200m² lot can hold eight times the floor area

items.name: 208-建蔽率と容積率
items.caption: 容積率（指定が 200% でも、4m 道路なら 160%）
items.captionEn: Floor-area ratio in Japan: a narrow street caps it below the zoned figure, so the road sizes the building

items.name: 215-NANDフラッシュの階層
items.caption: NAND フラッシュ（読み書きはページ、消去はブロック）
items.captionEn: NAND flash: reads and writes go by the page, erases only by the block — every other property of an SSD follows from that mismatch

items.name: 207-ウェハのダイ取り
items.caption: ダイ取り（大きいダイほど、端で捨てる割合が増える）
items.captionEn: Die-per-wafer: squares in a circle, so the bigger the die the larger the share thrown away

items.name: 203-壁量計算と4分割法
items.caption: 壁量（足りていても、偏っていれば通らない）
items.captionEn: Japanese timber wall-quantity check: enough shear wall still fails if it sits on one side

items.name: 202-斜線制限
items.caption: 斜線制限（家の形は、敷地ではなく斜めの線で決まる）
items.captionEn: Japanese setback planes: the shape of a house is decided by slanting lines, not by the plot

items.name: 216-日本の硬貨6種
items.caption: 硬貨（大きさの順と、額面の順は一致しない）
items.captionEn: Japanese coins: the order by size is not the order by value, so the hand reads the hole first, then the reeding, and only then the size

items.name: 199-日本銀行券の識別マーク
items.caption: 識別マーク（形は同じ。位置で券種を分ける）
items.captionEn: Banknote tactile marks: the shape is identical, and only its position tells the denomination

items.name: 195-学校の机と椅子
items.caption: 机と椅子（大きさは学年ではなく身長。同じ号数で組む）
items.captionEn: School desks and chairs are sized by height, not by year, and the pair must match

items.name: 193-カードの版面
items.caption: カードの版面（裏面は 180° 回して同じでなければならない）
items.captionEn: A trading card layout: the back must look the same upside down, or the face is readable from the table

items.name: 229-折丁と台割
items.caption: 折丁（背標は重ねると階段になる。崩れたら順番が違う）
items.captionEn: Signatures and the page plan: collation marks step down the spine, so one signature out of order breaks the staircase — an inspection turned into a shape

items.name: 190-中綴じの面付け
items.caption: 面付け（左右のページの合計は、いつも総ページ ＋ 1）
items.captionEn: Saddle-stitch imposition: facing page numbers always add up to the page count plus one

items.name: 189-点字ブロック
items.caption: 点字ブロック（種類は 2 つ。1 枚に縮尺が 2 つ）
items.captionEn: Tactile paving: only two kinds, and one line tells you which side the platform is on

items.name: 188-裁判員裁判の法廷
items.caption: 法廷（検察官は裁判官から見て右 ＝ 傍聴席から見て左）
items.captionEn: A lay-judge courtroom: the prosecution sits on the bench’s right, so on the plan it is on the left

items.name: 218-窯詰めの棚組み
items.caption: 窯詰め（棚板 1 枚に支柱 3 本。3 点は必ず平面に乗る）
items.captionEn: Kiln loading: three posts per shelf, because three points always lie in one plane — and bisque and glaze firings are packed in opposite ways

items.name: 243-はめあい
items.caption: はめあい（同じ φ30 でも、記号で回るか外れないかが変わる）
items.captionEn: The same 30mm turns into a running fit or a permanent one depending on two letters: H7/g6 leaves 7 to 41 microns of clearance, H7/p6 always bites by at least 1 micron

items.name: 242-溶接記号
items.caption: 溶接記号（基線の下が矢の側、上がその反対側）
items.captionEn: A welding symbol is read together with its arrow: below the reference line means the arrow side, above it means the other side, so the same symbol welds the opposite face if the arrow moves

items.name: 238-板金の展開図
items.caption: 板金（外側寸法を足しただけでは合わない）
items.captionEn: A flat pattern is not the sum of the outside dimensions: the outside stretches when you bend it, and the amount subtracted is each shop measured value, not a standard

items.name: 187-合板の木取り図

items.captionEn: Extinguishers and hose reels, measured two different ways

items.name: 145-Sprinkler-layout
items.caption: スプリンクラーの配置（面積と間隔、2 つ同時に決まる）
items.captionEn: Sprinkler layout: area per head and spacing, decided together

items.name: 154-Fire-alarm-plan

items.name: 159-Fire-IAP-map

items.captionEn: A surface chart: the barbs tell you which way the front is moving

items.caption: 花火大会の保安距離図（号数ごとの円）
items.captionEn: Fireworks safety distances, a circle per shell size

items.name: 106-雑踏警備計画図
items.caption: 雑踏警備計画図（流せる量と入ってくる量）
items.captionEn: Crowd plan: how many can flow out against how many come in

items.name: 268-人口ピラミッドの読み方
items.caption: 人口ピラミッド（段は年齢、意味は生まれた年）
items.captionEn: A population pyramid is not a picture of today but eighty years of births stacked upright: the bulges and the notch move up one step every year, and the notch at 1966 records a year people avoided, not a generation that was lost

items.name: 267-クモの円網
items.caption: クモの円網（縦糸は歩く道、横糸だけが粘る）
items.captionEn: A spider does not stick to its own web because only the spiral is sticky: the radials and the temporary scaffold are dry, and the scaffold is cut away as the sticky spiral is laid from the outside in

items.name: 293-立体構造を決めるまで
items.caption: 立体構造を決めるまで（位相は、回折には写らない）
items.captionEn: Diffraction records only intensities, never phases, so a crystallographer has to fetch the phases from somewhere else — a known structure, anomalous scattering, or a heavy-atom derivative — whereas cryo-EM has no phase problem at all and pays instead by having to average tens of thousands of particles

items.name: 291-たんぱく質のトポロジー図
items.caption: たんぱく質のトポロジー図（長さを捨てて、畳み方だけを残す）
items.captionEn: Throw away every length and only the fold is left: a TOPS cartoon draws helices as circles and strands as triangles, and whether a connecting line stops at the edge of a symbol or runs into its centre is what tells you which end of the strand it joins — so two proteins of very different size can share one diagram

items.name: 303-ISBNの作り
items.caption: ISBN の作り（桁数が動くのは、真ん中の 2 つだけ）
items.captionEn: Only the middle two fields of an ISBN change length, so a publisher that issues many books holds a short registrant number and gets a longer title field in return — and the check digit, a weighted sum of alternating 1s and 3s, is deliberately imperfect: swapping two adjacent digits that differ by five slips straight through

items.name: 300-日本の硬貨
items.caption: 日本の硬貨（大きさは、価値の順に並んでいない）
items.captionEn: Three orderings that never agree: the 50 yen coin is smaller than the 5, the 10 is bigger than the 100, and the weights rank differently again — the only two with holes are the 5 and the 50, which are then told apart by the milled edge, because the set is designed to be read by hand

items.name: 290-ラマチャンドランプロット
items.caption: ラマチャンドランプロット（主鎖の形は、角 2 つでほぼ決まる）
items.captionEn: Two angles per residue are almost the whole story of a protein backbone: the peptide bond is a partial double bond so omega barely turns, leaving phi and psi, and each secondary structure lands in its own patch of the plot — which is why structure validation is done on six separate plots, since glycine and proline are allowed quite different places

items.name: 233-周期表の形
items.caption: 周期表（列の幅 2・6・10・14 は、軌道の定員）
items.captionEn: The shape of the periodic table is the electron configuration: block widths of 2, 6, 10 and 14 are orbital capacities, so no other width is possible

items.name: 227-三角定規と分度器
items.caption: 三角定規（2 枚だと、作れる角が 4 → 10 に増える）
items.captionEn: Two set squares come as a pair because two of them make ten angles in 15-degree steps, where one alone makes only four

items.name: 219-算数数学の問題図
items.caption: 問題図（数を並べる場所ではない。印が意味を運ぶ）
items.captionEn: Figures in maths problems: the marks carry the meaning — equal ticks, right-angle squares, parallel chevrons — and only the given values are written on the figure

items.name: 209-コンパスと定規の作図
items.caption: 作図（目盛りは使わない。同じ開きが等しい長さを作る）
items.captionEn: Ruler-and-compass constructions: no scale is used, because equal compass openings make equal lengths

items.name: 198-ミツバチの巣房
items.caption: 巣房（同じ面積を囲むのに、六角は壁がいちばん短い）
items.captionEn: Honeycomb cells: for a given area the hexagon has the shortest wall of any shape that tiles

items.name: 197-等角図と三面図
items.caption: 等角図（3 方向を同じ物差しで測れる。円は楕円になる）
items.captionEn: Isometric, third-angle and oblique: one scale serves all three axes, but circles become ellipses

items.name: 196-勾配の書き方
items.caption: 勾配（度で書く図面のほうが少ない）
items.captionEn: Slope notation: roofs in sun, ramps in fractions, roads in percent, railways in per mille — degrees are the minority

items.name: 194-点字の6点
items.caption: 点字（6 点しかない。「あ」と「1」は同じ形）
items.captionEn: Braille has only six dots, so “a” and “1” are the same shape until a number sign says otherwise

items.name: 192-サッカーボールの形
items.caption: サッカーボール（頂点の角は 348°。足りない 12° が球にする）
items.captionEn: A football is a truncated icosahedron: the 12 degrees missing at every vertex are what make it a sphere

items.name: 191-凸レンズの作図
items.caption: 凸レンズ（引く線は 3 本。2 本で像が決まる）
items.captionEn: Ray tracing through a convex lens: there are only three lines to draw, and two of them fix the image

items.name: 210-楽譜の寸法
items.caption: 楽譜（五線の間隔が、すべての寸法の単位）
items.captionEn: Music engraving: the staff space is the unit for every measurement, and the stem is 3.5 of them

items.name: 206-ピアノのアクション
items.caption: ピアノ（ハンマーは、最後は誰も押していない）
items.captionEn: A piano action: the jack lets go just before the string, so nothing is pushing the hammer at impact

items.name: 205-ホールの初期反射
items.caption: 初期反射（遅れは、距離の差そのもの。1ms ＝ 0.34m）
items.captionEn: Hall acoustics: delay is nothing but a difference in path length — one millisecond is 0.34 m

items.name: 204-ギターのフレット位置
items.caption: フレット（等間隔ではない。12 でちょうど半分）
items.captionEn: Guitar frets are a geometric series, and the saddle must still be moved back to play in tune

items.name: 307-乾電池の規格
items.caption: 乾電池の規格（番号の順は、大きさの順ではない）
items.captionEn: The numbering is not a size order: an AA cell is half a millimetre taller than a C cell, and an N cell is fatter than an AAA — all of them are 1.5 volts, so what a bigger cell buys is current and hours, not strength, and a button cell number like CR2032 is simply its diameter and height in millimetres

items.name: 248-電子レンジの構造
items.caption: 電子レンジ（加熱ムラの間隔 6.1cm は、作りでは消せない）
items.captionEn: Hot and cold spots sit 6.1cm apart because that is half of the 12.2cm wavelength, which no cabinet design can remove — so the food is moved instead

items.name: 252-サイクロン掃除機の分け方
items.caption: サイクロン（細くすると強くなるが、通せる空気が減る）
items.captionEn: Centrifugal force is v squared over r, so a tenth of the radius is ten times the g — but a tenth of the radius is a hundredth of the airflow, which is why the small cones come in rows

items.name: 251-IHの原理
items.caption: IH（熱くなるのは鍋底の 0.05mm だけ）
items.captionEn: Induction heats only the outer 0.05mm of the pan, and that thin skin is why iron works and aluminium does not: at 20kHz iron's surface resistance is 43 times aluminium's

items.name: 250-ドラム式洗濯機の構造
items.caption: 洗濯機（同じドラムで、1G 未満と 335G を切り替える）
items.captionEn: The same drum has to stay under 1G to wash and reach 335G to spin, which is why it hangs on springs behind a concrete weight rather than being bolted to the machine

items.name: 247-エアコンの四方弁
items.caption: エアコン（替わるのは弁ひとつ。役目が入れ替わる）
items.captionEn: Heating and cooling swap the roles of the indoor and outdoor coils, and the only part that changes is one valve — which is also why a heat pump briefly runs cooling in the middle of heating, to melt its own frost

items.name: 306-水が蛇口に届くまで
items.caption: 水が蛇口に届くまで（塩素は、2 回入れる）
items.captionEn: Chlorine goes in twice, and the two doses are for different things: the first, before filtration, is part of the treatment, while the second is there to still be working when the water reaches a tap — and the coagulation stage is two basins, one that stirs fast and one that stirs slowly, because the floc has to be grown before it will settle

items.name: 260-スライド丁番のかぶせ量
items.caption: 丁番（扉の幅は、丁番を決めてから出す）
items.captionEn: You cannot size a cabinet door until the hinge is chosen: the overlay goes straight into the width, and full overlay versus inset differs by 18mm per door

items.name: 261-電源タップの定格
items.caption: 電源タップ（つないでも足し算にならない）
items.captionEn: Chaining power strips does not add up: the wall socket caps the whole chain at 15A, the flex gauge caps it lower still (0.75sq means 7A), and the 20A branch breaker trips after the 15A strip has already overheated

items.name: 289-自転車ホイールの組み方
items.caption: 自転車ホイールの組み方（交差のしかたが、そのまま名前になる）
items.captionEn: A spoke pattern is named after how it crosses, not how it connects: three crossings per spoke is a 3-cross, also called six-spoke because the sixth spoke counted from the reference is the one it meets, and the half-pitch offset between the two hub flanges is what separates JIS lacing from Italian

items.name: 262-木工の組み手
items.caption: 木工の組み手（蟻の勾配・ほぞの 3 分の 1・木の動き）
items.captionEn: Dovetail slope is the limit before the corner grain snaps (1:6 in softwood, 1:8 in hardwood), a tenon is one third of the stock, and a 600mm top moves 9mm across the grain — so the joint that fails is usually the one that was not allowed to move

items.name: 263-加湿器の方式
items.caption: 加湿器（違うのは、蒸発させる熱をどこから取るか）
items.captionEn: Every humidifier needs the same 627Wh to evaporate a litre — the four types differ only in where that heat comes from, which is why the evaporative one is cheap on the meter and cools the room instead

items.name: 272-空気清浄機の中身
items.caption: 空気清浄機（「8 畳」は 8 畳用という意味ではない）
items.captionEn: The order of the filters is the order of their lifetimes, and the room size on the box is really a time: it names the room this machine can clean in thirty minutes, so a room its own size takes the full half hour

items.name: 273-洗濯表示の読み方
items.caption: 洗濯表示（形が処理、付ける印が条件）
items.captionEn: Care labels have only five base shapes — tub, triangle, square, iron, circle — and everything else is a mark added to them; the number is a ceiling, not an instruction, and in 2024 the iron temperatures moved up 10 degrees without the symbols changing

items.name: 259-家具の転倒防止
items.caption: 転倒防止（倒れやすさに、重さは関係ない）
items.captionEn: Mass cancels out of the tipping condition, so how easily furniture falls depends only on its depth and the height of its centre of gravity — a shallow tall bookcase goes over at a shindo 5+

items.name: 258-液晶テレビの層
items.caption: 液晶（光を作らない。遮るだけ。だから黒が沈まない）
items.captionEn: An LCD makes no light of its own — it only blocks it, which is why its black is whatever light failed to be blocked, and why only a tenth of the backlight ever reaches your eye

items.name: 257-換気扇の風量と静圧
items.caption: 換気扇（カタログの風量は、ダクト無しの数字）
items.captionEn: The airflow on the box is the free-delivery figure; what you actually get is where the fan curve meets the duct resistance, and a long bent duct can cut it to 43 percent

items.name: 256-食洗機の水の道
items.caption: 食洗機（同じ水を何度も回す。減るのは捨てる水だけ）
items.captionEn: A dishwasher does not use less water, it uses the same water many times: 10 litres pumped around twenty times is 200 litres of water hitting the dishes

items.name: 255-炊飯器の温度と圧力
items.caption: 炊飯器（足されているのは弁ひとつ。100℃ を超えるため）
items.captionEn: Boiling water refuses to go past 100C, so a pressure cooker adds exactly one part — a valve — to lift that ceiling to about 105C

items.name: 254-給湯器の号数
items.caption: 給湯器（号数は流量ではなく熱量。冬は半分以下になる）
items.captionEn: A water heater is rated in heat, not flow: the same 24-go unit gives 40 litres a minute in summer and 17 in winter, because the rating assumes a 25 degree rise

items.name: 246-冷蔵庫の中身
items.caption: 冷蔵庫（冷やしていない。熱を外へ運び出している）
items.captionEn: A fridge does not make cold, it pumps heat out — and it throws away more than it took, because the compressor's electricity comes out as heat too

items.name: 186-冷蔵庫の据付と搬入
items.caption: 冷蔵庫の据付（「何センチ空ける」の一般解は無い。角は対角で決まる）
items.captionEn: Fitting a refrigerator: clearances differ by model, and a corner turns on the diagonal

items.name: 253-引き出しのスライドレール
items.caption: スライドレール（幅を決めるのは、レールの厚み）
items.captionEn: The slide decides the drawer, not the other way round: a side-mounted pair takes 12.7mm each side, so a 500mm opening leaves a 474.6mm box

items.name: 249-棚板のたわみ
items.caption: 棚板（材料を替えるより、形を変えるほうが効く）
items.captionEn: A shelf sags with the cube of its span, so doubling the span sags it eight times — and gluing a 40mm rail under the front edge does more than upgrading the board

items.name: 201-椅子の製作図
items.caption: 椅子（後脚に 4 方向からほぞが入る。高さをずらす）
items.captionEn: A chair drawn for making: four tenons meet in the back leg, and they must be set at different heights

items.name: 200-作業机の製作図
items.caption: 製作図（ほぞ先は留めに切る。天板は固定しない）
items.captionEn: A bench built for making: tenons mitred where they meet, and a top that is never screwed down

items.name: 264-配光曲線と照度計算
items.caption: 配光曲線（lm は器具の話、lx は机の上の話）
items.captionEn: The lumens on the box describe the fitting, not the desk: a polar candela plot is the only document that connects them, and at 2.5m a spot that gives 400lx underneath gives 110lx just 1.4m to the side

items.name: 245-エスカレーターの構造
items.caption: エスカレーター（踏面はいつも水平。離れるから階段に見える）
items.captionEn: The tread is always horizontal: the staircase appears because the front and rear rollers run on separate rails, and where those two rails come together the steps flatten out at the landing

items.name: 244-エレベーターの構造
items.caption: エレベーター（釣合おもりは、差を半分にするためにある）
items.captionEn: The counterweight is not there to cancel the weight but to halve the difference: car plus half the rated load, so the motor only ever lifts half the rated load in either direction

items.name: 223-海図の読み方
items.caption: 海図（1 枚に基準面が 3 つある）
items.captionEn: A nautical chart carries three datums at once: depths from the lowest water, clearances from the highest, and light heights from the mean — each taken at its worst case

items.name: 174-送電線路の縦断面図
items.caption: 送電線路の縦断面図（電線は垂れる。垂れても届かない高さを決める）
items.captionEn: A transmission line profile: the wire sags, and the towers are sized so it still clears

items.name: 163-Residential-duct-layout
items.caption: ダクトの配置（部屋ではなく、圧力の予算で太さが決まる）
items.captionEn: Ducts are sized by a pressure budget, not by the room

items.name: 18-配管の系統
items.caption: 配管の系統（P&ID）
items.captionEn: Piping and instrumentation diagram

items.name: 38-計装ループ図
items.caption: 計装ループ図（TIC-101）
items.captionEn: Instrument loop diagram (ISA tags)

items.name: 19-受変電の結線
items.caption: 受変電の結線（単線結線図）
items.captionEn: Substation single-line diagram

items.name: 142-Panel-schedule
items.caption: 分電盤の回路表（表の形が、盤の形）
items.captionEn: Panel schedule: the table is shaped like the panel

items.name: 164-小学校の回路図
items.caption: 小学校の回路図（回路は「わ」。記号は 3 つで足りる）
items.captionEn: The circuit diagram taught at primary school: series and parallel

items.name: 50-電子回路図
items.caption: 電子回路図（IEC／JIS 記号）
items.captionEn: Electronic circuit (IEC symbols)

items.name: 06-家の電気系統
items.caption: 住宅の電気系統
items.captionEn: House electrical layout

items.name: 10-給排水の系統
items.caption: 住宅の給排水
items.captionEn: House water and drainage

items.name: 103-陸上養殖の循環系統図
items.caption: 陸上養殖の循環系統図（水を捨てずに直す）
items.captionEn: Land-based aquaculture: the water is cleaned, not replaced

items.name: 35-配水系統図
items.caption: 配水系統図（上水道）
items.captionEn: Water distribution network

items.name: 44-人工衛星の系統図
items.caption: 人工衛星の系統図（150kg 級）
items.captionEn: Satellite subsystems

items.name: 301-治験の三つの相
items.caption: 治験の三つの相（人数ではなく、「誰に試すか」で分かれている）
items.captionEn: The phases of a clinical trial are not divided by how many people take part but by who they are — healthy volunteers, then a few mildly affected patients, then the people who would actually use the drug — and only the last of the three is described as verifying efficacy rather than examining it

items.name: 296-献血から輸血まで
items.caption: 献血から輸血まで（同じ 1 本の血から、保ちの違う 3 つができる）
items.captionEn: One donation splits into three products that keep for wildly different times — red cells 28 days cold, plasma a year frozen, platelets just four days at room temperature — which is why plasma can be stockpiled and platelets cannot, and why the shortage people talk about is almost always the four-day one

items.name: 292-製麹の品温
items.caption: 製麹の品温（時計ではなく、温度で次へ進む）
items.captionEn: Growing koji is two days of walking a temperature up and stopping it at the top: the mould heats itself as it grows, so the maker cannot hold the temperature down — only decide how often to break the rice up, and the shape of that climb is the recipe

items.name: 287-日本酒の三段仕込み
items.caption: 日本酒の三段仕込み（糖化と発酵が、同じタンクで同時に進む）
items.captionEn: Sake is the rare brew where starch is turned to sugar and sugar to alcohol in the same tank at the same time, so the rice is added in three goes over four days — one sixth, then two, then three — because pouring it all in at once would dilute the lactic acid that keeps the starter safe

items.name: 286-魚の三枚おろし
items.caption: 魚の三枚おろし（包丁の向きは、中骨が決める）
items.captionEn: Which way the knife travels is decided by the backbone, not by the cook: the belly side is cut head to tail and the back side tail to head, and a cross-section shows the two cuts running either side of the bone to leave three pieces — right fillet, left fillet, bone

items.name: 282-ランドルト環
items.caption: ランドルト環（1.0 は大きさではなく、角度の約束）
items.captionEn: Visual acuity 1.0 is an angle, not a size: the gap must subtend one minute of arc and the whole ring five, which is why a chart for 5m and one for 3m print rings of different sizes

items.name: 277-食品トレーサビリティ
items.caption: 食品トレーサビリティ（1 段ずつの記録が、鎖になる）
items.captionEn: Each business records only one step back and one step forward; the chain is what makes the whole route traceable, so one missing record breaks it — and the lot size chosen at the factory decides how much has to be recalled

items.name: 276-ケーキのデコレーション指示図
items.caption: ケーキのデコレーション（飾りの数は、切る数で決まる）
items.captionEn: How many strawberries go on a cake is decided by how many slices it will be cut into, and they sit between the cut lines rather than on them — a berry on the line is halved by the knife and lands on two plates

items.name: 275-寿司桶の盛付指示図
items.caption: 寿司桶の盛付（器の形が、並べ方を決める）
items.captionEn: The shape of the vessel decides the arrangement: a round tub is divided radially so every seat sees the same face, while a rectangular plate carries a flowing arrangement because there is only one direction to look from

items.name: 266-足関節のテーピング
items.caption: テーピング（止めるのは 1 方向だけ）
items.captionEn: Ankle taping stops one direction only — inversion — and leaves the up-and-down movement alone; the order matters because each strip pins down the ends of the last, so tape that peels is usually tape applied in the wrong order

items.name: 158-Cattle-handling-facility
items.caption: 牛の取扱い施設（寸法が、牛のすることから決まる）
items.captionEn: Every dimension comes from what cattle will not do

items.name: 213-血球計算盤の目盛り
items.caption: 血球計算盤（深さ 0.100mm が、面積を体積に変える）
items.captionEn: Haemocytometer grid: the 0.100mm depth is what turns an area into a volume, so one 1mm square holds exactly 0.1 microlitres

items.name: 72-歯周チャート
items.caption: 歯周精密検査チャート（32 歯 × 6 点）
items.captionEn: Periodontal chart, six points a tooth

items.name: 146-Restorative-chart
items.caption: 歯の修復記録（1 本の番号で歯が決まる）
items.captionEn: Restorative chart: one number fixes a tooth

items.name: 39-経絡と経穴
items.caption: 経絡と経穴（鍼灸・WHO 標準）
items.captionEn: Meridians and points (WHO standard)

items.name: 36-手術室の機器配置
items.caption: 手術室の機器配置（OR-3）
items.captionEn: Operating room equipment layout

items.name: 09-患者の動線
items.caption: 外来の流れ
items.captionEn: Outpatient flow

items.name: 108-おせち重箱の詰め方
items.caption: おせち重箱の詰め方（奇数で、隙間を残さない）
items.captionEn: New year box: odd numbers, and no gaps

items.name: 104-牛枝肉の部分肉分割図
items.caption: 牛枝肉の部分肉分割図（境目は骨で決まる）
items.captionEn: Beef cutting chart: the bones decide the lines

items.name: 23-厨房の動線
items.caption: 厨房の区域と動線（HACCP）
items.captionEn: Kitchen zones and one-way flow (HACCP)

items.name: 115-食品工場のアレルゲン動線図
items.caption: 食品工場のアレルゲン動線図（戻り道を作らない）
items.captionEn: Allergen flow: never let the path double back

items.name: 240-地の目とバイアス
items.caption: 地の目（伸びているのは糸ではない。織り目の角が倒れている）
items.captionEn: Cloth stretches on the 45 degree bias because nothing stretches: the woven square shears into a rhombus, so at a 120 degree cell the length gains 22.5 percent while the width loses 29.3 percent — it narrows more than it lengthens

items.name: 239-縫い方の番号
items.caption: 縫い方の番号（「本縫いで」ではなく「301 で」と書く）
items.captionEn: Stitches are specified by number, not by name: 301 rather than "lockstitch" — three digits for the stitch, five for the seam, and the two standards are separate because thread and cloth are decided separately
